note: Byte-exact reference corpus of the rules at parent build 1040. Map lines re-recorded twice: 2026-10-04 (four conditions) and again 2026-10-05, when the recorder's missing terrain size argument was found and fixed — the first re-recording had generated 200-unit islands with the spawn ring outside the map. The contract of the RULES, not of any port.

golden/turn1-b1040.jsonl.note: legacy capture: near the opening state (unit positions match t=0) but NOT reproducible from today's reference at any whole step — clock, population, map/nodes/nearestNodes differ; kept for provenance, not the port oracle

golden/map-line-b1040.json.note: the true 800-world map, post Town Center clearance, re-recorded 5 Oct 2026 (the recorder size bug fixed: it had generated a 200-unit island); 941 nodes, golden/medium/4

golden/turn1-b1040.canonical.jsonl.note: turn1-b1040.jsonl with seat ids re-keyed to seat<N>; the form a port compares against, because v1 mints seat ids from Math.random by design

golden/map-alpha-easy-2.json.note: easy, 2 seats, re-recorded 5 Oct 2026 at the true 800-world size; tests the multiplier table and rotational rounding at two seats

golden/map-alpha-hard-3.json.note: hard, 3 seats, re-recorded 5 Oct 2026 at the true 800-world size; stone is 21 here: round(20/3)=7 per seat, where ceil would say 42

golden/map-beta-medium-4.json.note: medium, 4 seats, different seed, re-recorded 5 Oct 2026 at the true 800-world size; the clearance removes four nodes in this layout

golden/states-b1040-t0-t1.canonical.json.note: per-seat state view at t=0 and t=1000 ms, English, ids canonical; regenerate with tools/golden/dump-states.cjs -at 0,1000 piped through canonicalize-states.cjs
